metaTitle: Custom Heart Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom heart-shaped lanyards and badges in bulk. Perfect for events, schools, and promotions. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Heart-shaped lanyards and badge holders add a touch of personality to your branded gear, making them ideal for charity events, Valentine's Day promotions, or any campaign centered around care and community. Unlike standard rectangular badges, the heart shape immediately conveys warmth and approachability. Choose from styles like the Rainbow Lanyard for pride events or the durable Super Value Lanyard for everyday use. Customize with full-color imprinting to match your logo or message. Perfect for marketing directors and HR directors looking to stand out.
heroAltText: Custom heart-shaped lanyards and badge holders in assorted colors, ideal for events and promotions.
